title: Forces, Work Done and Elasticity
opener_concept: Hooke's law by pattern-spotting: hang weights on a spring (1 N to 2 cm, 2 N to 4 cm), predict 3 N to 6 cm and back-solve 10 cm to 5 N; reveal names F=ke and the e-squared jump of elastic PE.

problems_fixed.what: Wrong stored answer for the bow/arrow launch speed. E=1/2ke^2 = 18 J then 1/2mv^2 = 18 gives v = sqrt(720) = 26.83 m/s; stored value was 60 (contradicted its own misconception text). Corrected solutions to [26.83], added unit m/s and accept 0.1, and appended 'Give your answer to 2 d.p.' to the display.
